content: In April 2023, Sudan descended into civil war following a fierce power struggle between the army and the RSF.
In April 2023, conflict erupted between the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) and the Sudanese army, resulting in what the UN describes as "devastating civilian casualties."
The army stated that this marked their 220th offensive, as the RSF, whose fighters have been gathering in trenches surrounding the city, often launches attacks on el-Fasher.
